starter_questions: Where can I see how many people entered and left?

setup_guide.introduction: The sample uses four cameras to track guest movement in a simulated hotel lobby. To set this up with your own cameras, share your camera configuration and a 3D scan of your space.

sample.title: Live hotel simulation
sample.description: Watch guests queue at reception and leave through two exits.
